source.title: Secure Boot SDK user guide
source.applicability: Manufacturer-specific technical documentation for implementing secure boot processes on PSoC 64 Secure MCUs, establishing hardware root of trust and validating firmware integrity during device startup

passages.text: The PSOC™ 64 Secure Boot MCU line, based on the PSOC™ 6 MCU platform, features out-of-box security functionality. This line provides an isolated Root of Trust (RoT) with true attestation and provisioning services
The PSOC™ 64 Secure Boot MCU now uses the OEM RoT public key as the root key to validate any OEM asset (for example, image keys, policies, etc.)

Secure Boot SDK user guide
About this document
Scope and purpose
This document serves as a guide for using the Secure Boot SDK. It explains the SDK overview, software
installation, provisioning flow, and CySecureTools design.
Intended audience
The Secure Boot SDK is intended for PSOC™ 64 device users.
